Whether you need an online store, a booking system, or a smart automated assistant to handle customer chats and routine paperwork, my focus is on making things simple and reliable.

Baik Anda membutuhkan website penjualan untuk toko, portal online untuk sekolah, maupun asisten pintar untuk membalas pesan pelanggan secara otomatis, fokus saya adalah membuat sistem yang mudah digunakan dan langsung bermanfaat.

projects.title: Corporate Risk Management Platform
projects.short_desc: An enterprise risk management solution combining digitalized document approval workflows with automation across risk calculations, legacy-to-new data mapping, and automated email reminders.
projects.short_desc_id: Solusi enterprise manajemen risiko yang menggabungkan digitalisasi alur persetujuan (approval workflow) dokumen dengan otomasi kalkulasi risiko, pemetaan (mapping) data lama ke baru, serta notifikasi pengingat (reminder) via email.
projects.full_desc: An enterprise-grade platform engineered to digitalize corporate risk management and automate operational workflows. Built with Django, Celery, and Redis, it digitalizes multi-tier document approval workflows and risk registers, while driving complete process automation across automated risk calculation engines, seamless legacy data mapping, and background email reminder schedulers.
projects.full_desc_id: Platform kelas enterprise yang dirancang untuk mendigitalisasi pengelolaan manajemen risiko korporasi sekaligus mengotomatisasi alur kerja operasional. Ditenagai Django, Celery, dan Redis, sistem ini mendigitalisasi alur persetujuan (approval workflow) dokumen bertingkat dan risk register, serta menghadirkan otomasi penuh pada kalkulasi risiko, pemetaan (mapping) data lama ke baru, dan pengiriman reminder email otomatis.
projects.executive_summary: Enterprise risk management platform replacing manual paper/spreadsheet processes. Digitalizes multi-tier document approval workflows and centralized risk registers while automating risk scoring calculations, legacy data mapping, and scheduled email reminders.
projects.executive_summary_id: Platform manajemen risiko enterprise yang menggantikan proses fisik/spreadsheet manual. Mendigitalisasi alur persetujuan (approval workflow) dokumen bertingkat dan registrasi risiko terpusat, serta mengotomatisasi kalkulasi skor risiko, pemetaan (mapping) data lama ke baru, dan pengiriman reminder email otomatis.
challenges: Data Inconsistency: Each analyst maintained different spreadsheet versions without a single source of truth.

Manual Approval Bottlenecks & No Reminders: Approvals were handled manually across 4 tiers without automated reminders, stretching processing time to 10–14 business days compared to fast digital workflows.
Manual Calculation Complexity: Risk scoring depended on manual calculations without automated tools, slowing down risk assessments and risking human errors.
Zero Audit Trail: Lack of traceable records on who approved risk assessments when loss events occurred.
challenges_id: Inkonsistensi data: Setiap analis punya versi file berbeda tanpa single source of truth.
Bottleneck approval manual & tanpa reminder: Persetujuan dilakukan secara manual di 4 tahapan tanpa pengingat otomatis, menyebabkan penundaan hingga 10–14 hari kerja (berbeda jauh dari alur digital).
Kalkulasi manual & lambat: Perhitungan skor risiko masih bergantung pada perhitungan manual tanpa alat otomatis, memperlambat asesmen dan rawan kesalahan hitung.
Tidak ada audit trail: Jika terjadi loss event, sulit melacak siapa yang menyetujui risk assessment terkait.

solutions.title: Automated Risk Calculation Engine
solutions.desc: Custom backend engine (Django + Celery) computing risk scores instantly based on department-defined Likelihood × Impact parameters, eliminating manual calculation overhead.
solutions.desc_id: Engine custom di backend (Django + Celery) menghitung risk score secara otomatis dan real-time berdasarkan parameter likelihood × impact, mempermudah dan mempercepat perhitungan tanpa proses manual.

solutions.title: Digital Approval Workflow & Automated Reminders
solutions.desc: Digital 4-tier approval pipeline (Risk Owner → Dept. Head → Risk Committee → CRO) with scheduled background email reminders, SLA timers, auto-escalation after 48h, and immutable audit logs.
solutions.desc_id: Workflow persetujuan digital 4 tingkat (Risk Owner → Dept. Head → Risk Committee → CRO) dilengkapi pengingat (reminder) email otomatis, SLA timer 48 jam, eskalasi otomatis, dan log persetujuan immutable.

solutions.title: Loss Event Tracking & Analytics
solutions.desc: Real-time incident tracking cataloging loss value, root risk event, and corrective action linked directly into monthly risk register trend dashboards.
solutions.desc_id: Setiap insiden kerugian dicatat dengan kategori, nilai kerugian, risk event terkait, dan tindakan korektif yang terhubung langsung ke dashboard risk register.

tech_reasons.reason: Strong ORM for complex relational data structures (Risk Register ↔ Approval Workflow ↔ Loss Event records).
tech_reasons.reason_id: ORM kuat untuk relasi data kompleks (Risk Register ↔ Approval Workflow ↔ Record Loss Event).

tech_reasons.reason: Asynchronous task queue for risk scoring engine and instant notification dispatches without blocking UI responsiveness.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Task queue asinkron untuk kalkulasi skor dan notifikasi tanpa blocking daya tanggap UI.

tech_reasons.reason: Automated background scheduler triggering quarterly risk reviews and SLA escalation checks.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Task scheduler otomatis menjadwalkan review risiko berkala dan pengecekan eskalasi SLA.

impacts.label: Approval Cycle Time Reduction
impacts.sub: Reduced from 14 days down to 2-3 business days
impacts.sub_id: Dari 14 hari menjadi 2-3 hari kerja

impacts.label: External Audit Disputes
impacts.sub: 100% immutable audit log availability
impacts.sub_id: Seluruh audit trail tersimpan rapi & immutable

impacts.label: Real-Time Risk Register Sync
impacts.sub: Eliminated fragmented spreadsheet versions
impacts.sub_id: Tidak ada lagi versi spreadsheet yang berbeda

impacts.label: Items Handled Flawlessly
impacts.sub: 200+ risk items & 50+ loss events in first 6 months
impacts.sub_id: 200+ risk item & 50+ loss event dalam 6 bulan pertama

projects.title: Zeroman Portfolio
projects.short_desc: A high-performance personal portfolio built with Nuxt 3, engineered to convert visitors into clients through clarity, speed, and credibility-first design.
projects.short_desc_id: Portofolio pribadi berkinerja tinggi yang dibangun dengan Nuxt 3, dirancang untuk mengubah pengunjung menjadi klien melalui tampilan yang jelas, cepat, dan berorientasi pada kepercayaan.
projects.full_desc: A production-grade personal portfolio engineered from scratch with Nuxt 3 and TypeScript. Every component is hand-crafted with a focus on Core Web Vitals, bilingual content architecture, and a structured project showcase that communicates technical depth to enterprise clients. The result: a sub-2-second load time, 100% mobile-responsive layout, and a conversion-optimized contact flow.
projects.full_desc_id: Portofolio profesional berstandar produksi yang dibangun dari nol menggunakan Nuxt 3 dan TypeScript. Setiap komponen dirancang dengan fokus pada Core Web Vitals, arsitektur konten bilingual, dan showcase proyek terstruktur yang mengkomunikasikan kedalaman teknis kepada klien enterprise. Hasilnya: waktu loading di bawah 2 detik, layout 100% responsif mobile, dan alur kontak yang dioptimalkan untuk konversi.
projects.executive_summary: A personal portfolio engineered to function as a client-acquisition tool, not just a visual showcase. Built with Nuxt 3, TypeScript, and custom CSS animations to achieve elite Core Web Vitals scores while presenting bilingual content and a structured case-study format for each project.
projects.executive_summary_id: Portofolio pribadi yang dirancang untuk berfungsi sebagai alat akuisisi klien, bukan sekadar tampilan visual. Dibangun dengan Nuxt 3, TypeScript, dan animasi CSS kustom untuk mencapai skor Core Web Vitals terbaik sekaligus menyajikan konten bilingual dan format studi kasus terstruktur untuk setiap proyek.
challenges: Professional Credibility: Without corporate brand backing, individual candidates struggle to convey enterprise-grade technical competence to hiring managers.
Content Architecture: Bilingual (ID/EN) content required a scalable, maintainable JSON data structure rather than hardcoded strings.
Performance vs. Animation: Rich CSS animations risked degrading Core Web Vitals (CLS, LCP) scores on mobile devices.
SEO for Portfolio Sites: Static portfolio pages typically rank poorly due to thin content and lack of structured data.
challenges_id: Kredibilitas Profesional: Tanpa dukungan brand perusahaan, kandidat individu sering kesulitan menyampaikan kompetensi teknis level enterprise kepada hiring manager.
Arsitektur Konten: Konten bilingual (ID/EN) membutuhkan struktur data JSON yang skalabel dan mudah dikelola, bukan string yang hardcoded.
Performa vs. Animasi: Animasi CSS yang kaya berisiko menurunkan skor Core Web Vitals (CLS, LCP) di perangkat mobile.
SEO untuk Situs Portofolio: Halaman portofolio statis umumnya memiliki peringkat rendah karena konten tipis dan kurangnya data terstruktur.

solutions.title: Credibility-First Case Study Format
solutions.desc: Each project entry includes quantified impact metrics, technical decision rationale, and challenge-solution narratives to demonstrate real-world expertise rather than just listing technologies.
solutions.desc_id: Setiap entri proyek menyertakan metrik dampak yang dikuantifikasi, alasan keputusan teknis, dan narasi tantangan-solusi untuk menunjukkan keahlian nyata, bukan sekadar daftar teknologi.

solutions.title: Centralized JSON Data Architecture
solutions.desc: All content — bilingual copy, project metadata, skills, testimonials — is stored in a single portfolio.json file, enabling instant content updates without touching Vue component logic.
solutions.desc_id: Semua konten — teks bilingual, metadata proyek, skill, testimoni — disimpan dalam satu file portfolio.json, memungkinkan pembaruan konten instan tanpa menyentuh logika komponen Vue.

solutions.title: Performance-Optimized Animations
solutions.desc: All CSS animations use GPU-accelerated properties (transform, opacity) and respect prefers-reduced-motion, ensuring zero CLS impact and accessibility compliance.
solutions.desc_id: Semua animasi CSS menggunakan properti yang dipercepat GPU (transform, opacity) dan menghormati prefers-reduced-motion, memastikan nol dampak CLS dan kepatuhan aksesibilitas.

tech_reasons.reason: SSR + static generation gives search engines fully-rendered HTML for each project page, critical for E-E-A-T SEO signals and fast First Contentful Paint.
tech_reasons.reason_id: SSR + static generation memberikan HTML yang sepenuhnya dirender untuk setiap halaman proyek ke mesin pencari, krusial untuk sinyal E-E-A-T SEO dan First Contentful Paint yang cepat.

tech_reasons.reason: Strict typing on portfolio data schemas prevents runtime errors and ensures content integrity across both language variants.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Pengetikan ketat pada skema data portofolio mencegah error runtime dan memastikan integritas konten di kedua varian bahasa.

tech_reasons.reason: Zero framework overhead. Every animation is hand-crafted with GPU-accelerated properties to maintain 60fps performance without importing heavy animation libraries.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Nol overhead framework. Setiap animasi dibuat secara manual dengan properti yang dipercepat GPU untuk mempertahankan performa 60fps tanpa mengimpor library animasi berat.

impacts.label: Page Load Time
impacts.sub: Consistently under 2 seconds on mobile (Nuxt SSR + optimized assets)
impacts.sub_id: Konsisten di bawah 2 detik di mobile (Nuxt SSR + aset teroptimasi)

impacts.sub_id: Layout sempurna di semua ukuran layar dari 320px hingga 4K

impacts.sub: Full EN/ID bilingual switch without page reload
impacts.sub_id: Pergantian bilingual EN/ID penuh tanpa reload halaman

projects.title: Employee Management System (HRIS)
projects.short_desc: A centralized HRIS platform handling employee attendance clock-in, daily work log reporting, leave requests, attendance history, automated payroll, contracts, and HR reporting.
projects.short_desc_id: Platform HRIS terpusat yang mengelola absensi karyawan, pengisian detail pekerjaan harian, riwayat absensi, pengajuan cuti, pembuatan slip gaji, hingga laporan HR.
projects.full_desc: A full-stack Human Resource Information System (HRIS) designed for both management and employee self-service. Employees can log daily attendance, submit detailed work activity logs, view complete attendance history, and submit leave requests. For management, it consolidates employee onboarding records, processes monthly payroll computation with automatic deduction rules, manages employment contracts with expiry alerts, and exports one-click HR reports.
projects.full_desc_id: Sistem Informasi Sumber Daya Manusia (HRIS) full-stack yang dirancang untuk manajemen sekaligus layanan mandiri karyawan (employee self-service). Karyawan dapat melakukan absensi harian, mengisi detail laporan pekerjaan harian, melihat riwayat absensi, dan mengajukan cuti. Dari sisi manajemen, sistem mengkonsolidasikan data karyawan, menghitung gaji bulanan otomatis, mengelola kontrak kerja dengan alarm kedaluwarsa, dan menyediakan ekspor laporan HR satu klik.
projects.executive_summary: A centralized HRIS platform featuring employee self-service (attendance clock-in, daily work log entry, attendance history, and leave request workflows) alongside automated payroll, contract management, and HR reporting for multi-department organizations.
projects.executive_summary_id: Platform HRIS terpusat yang dilengkapi layanan mandiri karyawan (absensi harian, pengisian detail pekerjaan harian, riwayat absensi, dan pengajuan cuti) serta otomatisasi gaji, manajemen kontrak, dan pelaporan HR untuk organisasi multi-departemen.
challenges: Data Fragmentation: HR, Finance, and Department heads each maintained separate employee files with no single source of truth.

Manual Data & Manipulation Risks: Monthly payroll calculated via manual spreadsheets was vulnerable to data input errors, formula miscalculations, and unauthorized tampering of overtime, deductions, or allowances.
No Contract Visibility: Employment contract expiry dates were tracked manually, causing unnoticed contract lapses.
High Concurrent Access: Multiple HR staff, department managers, and employees needed simultaneous access for daily attendance logging, work reporting, and payroll processing without data corruption.
challenges_id: Fragmentasi Data: HR, Keuangan, dan Kepala Departemen masing-masing menyimpan file karyawan terpisah tanpa single source of truth.

Potensi Kesalahan & Manipulasi Data: Penghitungan gaji bulanan via spreadsheet manual rawan kesalahan input data, formula tidak akurat, serta manipulasi tidak sah pada lembur, potongan, maupun tunjangan.
Tidak Ada Visibilitas Kontrak: Tanggal kedaluwarsa kontrak kerja dilacak manual, menyebabkan kontrak yang terlewat tidak terdeteksi.
Akses Konkuren Tinggi: Banyak staf HR, manajer, dan karyawan membutuhkan akses simultan untuk absensi harian, pengisian detail kerja, dan penggajian tanpa korupsi data.

solutions.title: Employee Self-Service Portal
solutions.desc: Empowers employees to record daily attendance, submit detailed daily work reports, view complete attendance logs, and file leave requests with automated manager approval routing.
solutions.desc_id: Memungkinkan karyawan melakukan absensi harian, mengisi laporan detail pekerjaan harian, melihat riwayat absensi lengkap, dan mengajukan cuti dengan alur persetujuan manajer otomatis.

solutions.title: Unified Employee Data Hub
solutions.desc: Single-source database with role-based access control (RBAC) separating Employee Self-Service, HR Admin, Department Manager, and Finance views.
solutions.desc_id: Database single-source dengan kontrol akses berbasis peran (RBAC) yang memisahkan tampilan Employee Self-Service, HR Admin, Manajer Departemen, dan Keuangan.

solutions.title: Automated Payroll Engine
solutions.desc: Rule-based payroll computation engine handling base salary, attendance deductions, overtime additions, and allowances automatically — generating printable payslips in one click.
solutions.desc_id: Engine penghitungan gaji berbasis aturan yang menangani gaji pokok, potongan absensi, tambahan lembur, dan tunjangan secara otomatis — menghasilkan slip gaji yang dapat dicetak dalam satu klik.

solutions.title: Contract Expiry Alert System
solutions.desc: Scheduled background jobs send automated email alerts 30/15/7 days before contract expiry, eliminating missed renewal risks for both probationary and fixed-term employees.
solutions.desc_id: Background job terjadwal mengirim peringatan email otomatis 30/15/7 hari sebelum kontrak kedaluwarsa, menghilangkan risiko pembaruan yang terlewat untuk karyawan probasi maupun kontrak tetap.

tech_reasons.reason: FastAPI with SQLAlchemy ORM provides efficient async transaction management for high-frequency attendance logs, daily work reports, and concurrent payroll writes; PostgreSQL handles complex JOIN queries across attendance, contract, and salary tables without performance degradation.
tech_reasons.reason_id: FastAPI dengan SQLAlchemy ORM menyediakan manajemen transaksi asinkron yang efisien untuk pencatatan absensi harian, detail pekerjaan, dan penulisan gaji konkuren; PostgreSQL menangani query JOIN kompleks di tabel absensi, kontrak, dan gaji tanpa penurunan performa.

tech_reasons.reason: Cron-like scheduler for automated contract expiry checks, leave quota reset tasks, and payroll report generation without manual HR intervention.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Scheduler mirip cron untuk pengecekan kedaluwarsa kontrak otomatis, reset kuota cuti, dan pembuatan laporan gaji tanpa intervensi HR manual.

tech_reasons.reason: Session caching for high-concurrency periods (daily peak morning attendance & payroll week) and task queue backend for background payslip generation jobs.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Caching sesi untuk periode konkuren tinggi (puncak absensi pagi & minggu penggajian) dan backend antrian tugas untuk job pembuatan slip gaji di latar belakang.

impacts.label: Payroll Accuracy
impacts.sub: Zero manual calculation errors since system deployment
impacts.sub_id: Nol kesalahan kalkulasi manual sejak sistem diterapkan

impacts.label: Missed Contract Renewals
impacts.sub: Automated 30/15/7-day alerts eliminated all lapsed contracts
impacts.sub_id: Peringatan otomatis 30/15/7 hari menghilangkan semua kontrak yang terlewat

impacts.label: Faster Payroll Processing
impacts.sub: Monthly payroll cut from 3 days manual work to under 1 day
impacts.sub_id: Penggajian bulanan dipangkas dari 3 hari kerja manual menjadi kurang dari 1 hari

impacts.label: Unified Data Source
impacts.sub: Replaced 6+ departmental spreadsheets with one access-controlled system
impacts.sub_id: Menggantikan 6+ spreadsheet departemen dengan satu sistem berkendalikan akses

projects.title: Secure Custom Knowledge Chatbot
projects.short_desc: An enterprise-grade AI chatbot with a company-specific knowledge base, dual access via UI or API keys, and an adaptive prompt injection detection system built on Graph RAG architecture.
projects.short_desc_id: Chatbot AI level enterprise dengan basis pengetahuan spesifik perusahaan, akses ganda via UI atau API key, dan sistem deteksi prompt injection adaptif yang dibangun di atas arsitektur Graph RAG.
projects.full_desc: A production-ready AI chatbot platform engineered for organizations that need secure, domain-specific conversational AI without the risks of generic LLM deployments. Clients upload their proprietary documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT) which are indexed into a Graph Knowledge structure for high-relevance retrieval. The system is accessible through a clean chat UI or via generated API keys for integration into existing platforms. Its core security layer uses an adaptive prompt injection detection engine that continuously learns from flagged user behavior, preventing jailbreaks and unauthorized data extraction attempts.
projects.full_desc_id: Platform chatbot AI siap produksi yang dirancang untuk organisasi yang membutuhkan AI percakapan domain-spesifik yang aman tanpa risiko deployment LLM generik. Klien mengunggah dokumen proprietary mereka (PDF, DOCX, TXT) yang diindeks ke dalam struktur Graph Knowledge untuk retrieval relevansi tinggi. Sistem dapat diakses melalui UI chat yang bersih atau via API key yang dihasilkan untuk integrasi ke platform yang sudah ada. Lapisan keamanan intinya menggunakan engine deteksi prompt injection adaptif yang terus belajar dari perilaku pengguna yang ditandai, mencegah jailbreak dan upaya ekstraksi data tidak sah.
projects.executive_summary: A white-label enterprise chatbot platform solving the core problem of generic AI: inability to answer company-specific questions. Built on Graph RAG architecture with an adaptive security layer, it serves as a secure internal knowledge assistant or customer-facing support agent.
projects.executive_summary_id: Platform chatbot enterprise white-label yang memecahkan masalah inti AI generik: ketidakmampuan menjawab pertanyaan spesifik perusahaan. Dibangun di atas arsitektur Graph RAG dengan lapisan keamanan adaptif, berfungsi sebagai asisten pengetahuan internal yang aman atau agen dukungan pelanggan.
challenges: Hallucination Risk: Generic LLMs answer questions outside their training data with confident but fabricated responses, unacceptable for enterprise use.
Prompt Injection Attacks: Bad actors attempt to override system instructions through crafted user inputs to extract confidential knowledge.
Context Fragmentation: Standard RAG with flat vector search loses relational context between documents, degrading answer quality.
Integration Friction: Organizations needed chatbot capabilities embedded in their existing tools, not a standalone platform requiring staff migration.
challenges_id: Risiko Halusinasi: LLM generik menjawab pertanyaan di luar data pelatihan mereka dengan respons yang percaya diri namun fabrikasi, tidak dapat diterima untuk penggunaan enterprise.
Serangan Prompt Injection: Aktor jahat mencoba mengganti instruksi sistem melalui input pengguna yang dirancang untuk mengekstrak pengetahuan rahasia.
Fragmentasi Konteks: RAG standar dengan pencarian vektor datar kehilangan konteks relasional antar dokumen, menurunkan kualitas jawaban.
Friction Integrasi: Organisasi membutuhkan kemampuan chatbot yang tertanam dalam alat mereka yang sudah ada, bukan platform mandiri yang memerlukan migrasi staf.

solutions.title: Graph RAG Knowledge Architecture
solutions.desc: Documents are parsed into entity-relationship graphs, preserving semantic connections between concepts. This enables multi-hop reasoning across documents that flat vector search cannot achieve.
solutions.desc_id: Dokumen diurai menjadi grafik entitas-relasi, mempertahankan koneksi semantik antar konsep. Ini memungkinkan penalaran multi-hop di seluruh dokumen yang tidak dapat dicapai oleh pencarian vektor datar.

solutions.title: Adaptive Prompt Injection Shield
solutions.desc: A multi-layer detection system combining rule-based pattern matching with a behavioral model that learns from flagged injection attempts, improving detection accuracy over time without retraining the base LLM.
solutions.desc_id: Sistem deteksi multi-layer yang menggabungkan pencocokan pola berbasis aturan dengan model perilaku yang belajar dari upaya injeksi yang ditandai, meningkatkan akurasi deteksi dari waktu ke waktu tanpa melatih ulang LLM dasar.

solutions.title: Dual-Mode API + UI Access
solutions.desc: Organizations receive a scoped API key with rate limiting and per-key knowledge base access controls, enabling seamless embedding into existing CRMs, intranets, or mobile apps.
solutions.desc_id: Organisasi menerima API key yang dibatasi scope dengan rate limiting dan kontrol akses knowledge base per-key, memungkinkan embedding mulus ke dalam CRM, intranet, atau aplikasi mobile yang sudah ada.

tech_reasons.reason: Combines graph traversal for relational context with vector similarity for semantic relevance, achieving answer precision that standard RAG cannot match on complex multi-document queries.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Menggabungkan traversal graf untuk konteks relasional dengan kemiripan vektor untuk relevansi semantik, mencapai presisi jawaban yang tidak dapat ditandingi RAG standar pada query multi-dokumen yang kompleks.

tech_reasons.reason: Model-agnostic routing enables switching between GPT-4, Claude, or open-source models based on cost/performance requirements without changing application code.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Routing model-agnostic memungkinkan peralihan antara GPT-4, Claude, atau model open-source berdasarkan kebutuhan biaya/performa tanpa mengubah kode aplikasi.

tech_reasons.reason: Async request handling for simultaneous multi-user chat sessions with sub-100ms API response times for non-LLM operations.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Penanganan request async untuk sesi chat multi-pengguna simultan dengan waktu respons API di bawah 100ms untuk operasi non-LLM.

Tantangannya adalah mengubah fotografi produk berkualitas tinggi menjadi storefront yang loading cepat tanpa mengorbankan kesetiaan visual. projects.title: Patuh PDP Multi-Tenant Compliance Platform
projects.short_desc: An enterprise multi-tenant SaaS platform with full-stack tenant isolation — from custom domains down to dedicated databases and isolated compute pods — engineered specifically for Indonesian UU PDP (Personal Data Protection Law) compliance.
projects.short_desc_id: Platform SaaS multi-tenant enterprise dengan isolasi tenant full-stack — dari domain kustom hingga database khusus dan pod komputasi terisolasi — dirancang khusus untuk kepatuhan UU PDP (Undang-Undang Perlindungan Data Pribadi) Indonesia.
projects.full_desc: A high-security multi-tenant platform architected to meet the strict isolation requirements of Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP No. 27/2022). Unlike conventional SaaS multi-tenancy where tenants share databases and compute resources, Patuh PDP implements a dedicated infrastructure model: each tenant organization receives its own domain/subdomain routing, an isolated PostgreSQL database connection, and separate containerized server pods orchestrated via Rancher. This architecture ensures that a data breach or misconfiguration affecting one tenant cannot cascade to another — a critical compliance requirement under UU PDP.
projects.full_desc_id: Platform multi-tenant keamanan tinggi yang dirancang untuk memenuhi persyaratan isolasi ketat dari Undang-Undang Perlindungan Data Pribadi Indonesia (UU PDP No. 27/2022). Berbeda dengan multi-tenancy SaaS konvensional di mana tenant berbagi database dan sumber daya komputasi, Patuh PDP mengimplementasikan model infrastruktur khusus: setiap organisasi tenant menerima routing domain/subdomainnya sendiri, koneksi database PostgreSQL yang terisolasi, dan pod server berkontainer terpisah yang diorkestrasikan melalui Rancher. Arsitektur ini memastikan bahwa pelanggaran data atau miskonfigurasi yang memengaruhi satu tenant tidak dapat merambat ke yang lain — persyaratan kepatuhan kritis di bawah UU PDP.
projects.executive_summary: Multi-tenant SaaS platform built specifically for UU PDP compliance, implementing true infrastructure-level tenant isolation. Designed to serve multiple client organizations on one codebase while guaranteeing that their personal data remains completely separated at every layer of the stack.
projects.executive_summary_id: Platform SaaS multi-tenant yang dibangun khusus untuk kepatuhan UU PDP, mengimplementasikan isolasi tenant tingkat infrastruktur yang sesungguhnya. Dirancang untuk melayani beberapa organisasi klien pada satu codebase sambil menjamin bahwa data pribadi mereka tetap sepenuhnya terpisah di setiap lapisan stack.
challenges: UU PDP Compliance: Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (effective 2024) mandates strict separation of personal data between organizations — shared-database multi-tenancy is a direct compliance violation.
Tenant Routing Complexity: Each tenant organization needs custom domain/subdomain routing to their isolated environment without cross-tenant data leakage risk.
Infrastructure Cost vs. Isolation: Dedicated infrastructure per tenant is expensive; shared infrastructure violates compliance. The architecture needed to balance both.
Operational Scalability: Onboarding a new tenant organization must be automatable — manual server provisioning per tenant is not viable at scale.
challenges_id: Kepatuhan UU PDP: Undang-Undang Perlindungan Data Pribadi Indonesia (berlaku 2024) mewajibkan pemisahan ketat data pribadi antar organisasi — multi-tenancy database bersama merupakan pelanggaran kepatuhan langsung.
Kompleksitas Routing Tenant: Setiap organisasi tenant membutuhkan routing domain/subdomain kustom ke lingkungan yang terisolasi tanpa risiko kebocoran data lintas-tenant.
Biaya Infrastruktur vs. Isolasi: Infrastruktur khusus per tenant mahal; infrastruktur bersama melanggar kepatuhan. Arsitektur perlu menyeimbangkan keduanya.
Skalabilitas Operasional: Onboarding organisasi tenant baru harus dapat diotomatisasi — provisi server manual per tenant tidak layak dalam skala besar.

solutions.title: Three-Layer Tenant Isolation Architecture
solutions.desc: Routing Layer: Custom domain/subdomain per tenant with automated Nginx config generation. Data Layer: Dedicated PostgreSQL connection pool per tenant with row-level encryption. Compute Layer: Isolated Docker container pods per tenant managed by Rancher.
solutions.desc_id: Lapisan Routing: Domain/subdomain kustom per tenant dengan generasi konfigurasi Nginx otomatis. Lapisan Data: Pool koneksi PostgreSQL khusus per tenant dengan enkripsi tingkat baris. Lapisan Komputasi: Pod kontainer Docker terisolasi per tenant yang dikelola oleh Rancher.

solutions.title: Automated Tenant Provisioning
solutions.desc: Fully scripted tenant onboarding pipeline: new organization registration triggers automatic database creation, container pod spin-up, subdomain DNS configuration, and SSL certificate provisioning — zero manual sysadmin steps.
solutions.desc_id: Pipeline onboarding tenant yang sepenuhnya di-script: pendaftaran organisasi baru memicu pembuatan database otomatis, spin-up pod kontainer, konfigurasi DNS subdomain, dan provisi sertifikat SSL — nol langkah sysadmin manual.

solutions.title: Compliance Audit Trail
solutions.desc: Immutable access logs capturing every data read/write event per tenant, with tenant-scoped export functionality enabling organizations to produce UU PDP audit reports on demand.
solutions.desc_id: Log akses immutable yang menangkap setiap peristiwa baca/tulis data per tenant, dengan fungsionalitas ekspor berbasis tenant yang memungkinkan organisasi menghasilkan laporan audit UU PDP sesuai permintaan.

tech_reasons.reason: Rancher provides centralized orchestration of isolated per-tenant container pods, enabling automated scaling and lifecycle management without manual server intervention per tenant.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Rancher menyediakan orkestrasi terpusat pod kontainer per-tenant yang terisolasi, memungkinkan scaling otomatis dan manajemen siklus hidup tanpa intervensi server manual per tenant.

tech_reasons.reason: Dedicated database connections per tenant — rather than schema-level separation — guarantees that a SQL injection in one tenant's environment cannot access another tenant's data.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Koneksi database khusus per tenant — daripada pemisahan tingkat skema — menjamin bahwa SQL injection di lingkungan satu tenant tidak dapat mengakses data tenant lain.

tech_reasons.reason: Service decomposition enables independent scaling of high-load tenant services without affecting co-located tenants, maintaining SLA guarantees even during peak usage by individual organizations.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Dekomposisi layanan memungkinkan scaling independen layanan tenant beban tinggi tanpa memengaruhi tenant yang berdampingan, mempertahankan jaminan SLA bahkan selama penggunaan puncak oleh organisasi individual.

projects.title: DMS AI — AI-Powered Document Management System
projects.title_id: DMS AI — Sistem Manajemen Dokumen Bertenaga AI
projects.short_desc: A high-throughput Document Management System powered by Go microservices and Python AI services communicating over gRPC, featuring semantic vector search via Qdrant for instant retrieval across thousands of enterprise documents.
projects.short_desc_id: Sistem Manajemen Dokumen high-throughput yang ditenagai microservices Go dan layanan AI Python yang berkomunikasi via gRPC, dengan pencarian vektor semantik melalui Qdrant untuk retrieval instan di ribuan dokumen enterprise.
projects.full_desc: An enterprise Document Management System engineered for organizations that manage large volumes of regulated documents (contracts, policies, compliance reports, technical manuals). The system addresses the fundamental failure of keyword search — documents found only when you know the exact words used. Using Qdrant vector database and OpenRouter-powered LLM embeddings, the DMS enables semantic search: users describe what they need in natural language and receive the most contextually relevant documents, even if those documents use entirely different terminology. Built on a Go (Golang) high-performance API gateway communicating with Python AI services via gRPC, orchestrated on Kubernetes for production reliability.
projects.full_desc_id: Sistem Manajemen Dokumen enterprise yang dirancang untuk organisasi yang mengelola volume besar dokumen teregulasi (kontrak, kebijakan, laporan kepatuhan, manual teknis). Sistem ini mengatasi kegagalan fundamental pencarian kata kunci — dokumen ditemukan hanya jika Anda mengetahui kata-kata persis yang digunakan. Menggunakan database vektor Qdrant dan embedding LLM yang ditenagai OpenRouter, DMS memungkinkan pencarian semantik: pengguna mendeskripsikan apa yang mereka butuhkan dalam bahasa natural dan menerima dokumen yang paling relevan secara kontekstual, bahkan jika dokumen tersebut menggunakan terminologi yang sama sekali berbeda. Dibangun di atas API gateway Go (Golang) berkinerja tinggi yang berkomunikasi dengan layanan AI Python via gRPC, diorkestrasikan di Kubernetes untuk keandalan produksi.
projects.executive_summary: Enterprise DMS solving the 'keyword search problem' in document retrieval: users cannot find what they need because they don't know the exact words in the document. Semantic vector search via Qdrant + LLM embeddings enables natural-language document discovery at enterprise scale, built on a Go + Python + gRPC microservices architecture.
projects.executive_summary_id: DMS enterprise yang memecahkan 'masalah pencarian kata kunci' dalam retrieval dokumen: pengguna tidak dapat menemukan apa yang mereka butuhkan karena mereka tidak mengetahui kata-kata persis dalam dokumen. Pencarian vektor semantik via Qdrant + embedding LLM memungkinkan penemuan dokumen bahasa natural dalam skala enterprise, dibangun di atas arsitektur microservices Go + Python + gRPC.
challenges: Keyword Search Failure: Traditional search forces users to remember exact document terminology. For regulatory and policy documents, this results in critical documents being 'hidden in plain sight'.
Concurrent Processing: Uploading and indexing large batches of documents (100+ files) blocked other users during indexing operations.
Cross-Service Latency: AI embedding generation (Python/ML) and document storage (Go/Postgres) needed to communicate without introducing response time bottlenecks.
Real-Time Collaboration: Multiple team members needed to see document status updates (indexed, processing, failed) in real time without polling.
challenges_id: Kegagalan Pencarian Kata Kunci: Pencarian tradisional memaksa pengguna mengingat terminologi dokumen yang persis. Untuk dokumen regulasi dan kebijakan, ini mengakibatkan dokumen kritis 'tersembunyi di depan mata'.
Pemrosesan Konkuren: Mengunggah dan mengindeks batch dokumen besar (100+ file) memblokir pengguna lain selama operasi pengindeksan.
Latensi Lintas-Layanan: Generasi embedding AI (Python/ML) dan penyimpanan dokumen (Go/Postgres) perlu berkomunikasi tanpa menimbulkan bottleneck waktu respons.
Kolaborasi Real-Time: Beberapa anggota tim perlu melihat pembaruan status dokumen (terindeks, diproses, gagal) secara real-time tanpa polling.

solutions.title: Semantic Vector Search via Qdrant
solutions.desc: Documents are chunked, embedded via OpenRouter LLM models, and stored as high-dimensional vectors in Qdrant. User queries are embedded at search time and matched by cosine similarity, returning semantically related documents regardless of exact keyword overlap.
solutions.desc_id: Dokumen di-chunk, di-embed via model LLM OpenRouter, dan disimpan sebagai vektor dimensi tinggi di Qdrant. Query pengguna di-embed pada waktu pencarian dan dicocokkan berdasarkan kemiripan kosinus, mengembalikan dokumen yang terkait secara semantik terlepas dari tumpang tindih kata kunci yang persis.

solutions.title: gRPC Async Document Processing Pipeline
solutions.desc: Document upload triggers an async gRPC stream to the Python AI service for non-blocking embedding generation. The Go gateway returns immediately to the user while background processing completes, eliminating indexing-induced UI blocking.
solutions.desc_id: Upload dokumen memicu stream gRPC async ke layanan AI Python untuk generasi embedding non-blocking. Gateway Go langsung kembali ke pengguna sementara pemrosesan latar belakang selesai, menghilangkan pemblokiran UI yang diinduksi pengindeksan.

solutions.title: WebSocket Real-Time Status Updates
solutions.desc: Persistent WebSocket connections push document processing status updates (uploaded → embedding → indexed → ready) to all connected team members in real time, eliminating the need to refresh or poll for document availability.
solutions.desc_id: Koneksi WebSocket persisten mendorong pembaruan status pemrosesan dokumen (diunggah → embedding → terindeks → siap) ke semua anggota tim yang terhubung secara real-time, menghilangkan kebutuhan untuk refresh atau polling ketersediaan dokumen.

tech_reasons.reason: Go's goroutine concurrency model handles thousands of simultaneous document requests with minimal memory overhead — critical for enterprise environments with 50+ concurrent users.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Model konkuren goroutine Go menangani ribuan request dokumen simultan dengan overhead memori minimal — kritis untuk lingkungan enterprise dengan 50+ pengguna konkuren.

tech_reasons.reason: Qdrant's HNSW indexing enables sub-100ms semantic search across 100,000+ document vectors — performance that PostgreSQL full-text search cannot approach for semantic similarity queries.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Pengindeksan HNSW Qdrant memungkinkan pencarian semantik di bawah 100ms di 100.000+ vektor dokumen — performa yang tidak dapat didekati PostgreSQL full-text search untuk query kemiripan semantik.

tech_reasons.reason: Binary protocol with Protocol Buffers reduces inter-service serialization overhead by 60-70% vs REST/JSON for high-frequency AI embedding generation calls.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Protokol biner dengan Protocol Buffers mengurangi overhead serialisasi antar layanan sebesar 60-70% vs REST/JSON untuk panggilan generasi embedding AI frekuensi tinggi.

tech_reasons.reason: Horizontal pod autoscaling for the Python AI service handles document batch spikes without manual intervention, maintaining consistent embedding throughput during peak upload periods.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Autoscaling pod horizontal untuk layanan AI Python menangani lonjakan batch dokumen tanpa intervensi manual, mempertahankan throughput embedding yang konsisten selama periode upload puncak.

impacts.label: Semantic Search Response
impacts.sub: Qdrant HNSW index returns relevant documents in under 100ms across 100K+ vectors
impacts.sub_id: Indeks HNSW Qdrant mengembalikan dokumen relevan dalam di bawah 100ms di 100K+ vektor

impacts.label: Inter-Service Overhead Reduction
impacts.sub: gRPC + Protobuf vs REST/JSON for AI embedding pipeline
impacts.sub_id: gRPC + Protobuf vs REST/JSON untuk pipeline embedding AI

impacts.label: UI Blocking During Indexing
impacts.sub: Async gRPC pipeline processes documents without blocking any user operations
impacts.sub_id: Pipeline gRPC async memproses dokumen tanpa memblokir operasi pengguna manapun

impacts.label: Search Interface
impacts.sub: Users describe what they need in plain language — no keyword memorization required
impacts.sub_id: Pengguna mendeskripsikan apa yang mereka butuhkan dalam bahasa biasa — tidak perlu menghafal kata kunci

projects.title: POV AI Indonesia — Economic Sentiment Intelligence Platform
projects.title_id: POV AI Indonesia — Platform Intelijen Sentimen Ekonomi
projects.short_desc: An automated AI intelligence platform that continuously monitors sensitive Indonesian economic indicators — BBM prices, USD/IDR exchange rates, and public sentiment — through scheduled multi-source web crawling and LLM-powered trend analysis.
projects.short_desc_id: Platform intelijen AI otomatis yang terus memantau indikator ekonomi sensitif Indonesia — harga BBM, nilai tukar USD/IDR, dan sentimen publik — melalui crawling web multi-sumber terjadwal dan analisis tren bertenaga LLM.
projects.full_desc: An autonomous economic intelligence system built to solve the information overload problem for analysts and decision-makers monitoring Indonesia's most politically sensitive economic indicators. The platform deploys scheduled web crawlers across financial media, government portals, and public discussion channels — automatically collecting data on BBM (fuel) price movements and USD/IDR exchange rate fluctuations. Collected data is fed into an LLM analysis pipeline that generates structured trend summaries, public sentiment scores, and executive-level conclusions — delivered in real time without human analyst intervention. The system runs fully autonomously on a cron-based scheduler, producing fresh intelligence every cycle.
projects.full_desc_id: Sistem intelijen ekonomi otonom yang dibangun untuk memecahkan masalah information overload bagi analis dan pengambil keputusan yang memantau indikator ekonomi paling sensitif secara politis di Indonesia. Platform ini menerapkan web crawler terjadwal di berbagai media keuangan, portal pemerintah, dan saluran diskusi publik — secara otomatis mengumpulkan data tentang pergerakan harga BBM dan fluktuasi nilai tukar USD/IDR. Data yang dikumpulkan dimasukkan ke pipeline analisis LLM yang menghasilkan ringkasan tren terstruktur, skor sentimen publik, dan kesimpulan tingkat eksekutif — disampaikan secara real-time tanpa intervensi analis manusia. Sistem berjalan sepenuhnya otonom pada scheduler berbasis cron, menghasilkan intelijen segar setiap siklus.
projects.executive_summary: Autonomous economic intelligence platform monitoring Indonesia's most politically sensitive indicators (BBM prices, Rupiah exchange rates) through multi-source scheduled crawling and LLM-powered analysis. Replaces hours of manual analyst research with automated, structured intelligence delivered in real time.
projects.executive_summary_id: Platform intelijen ekonomi otonom yang memantau indikator paling sensitif secara politis di Indonesia (harga BBM, nilai tukar Rupiah) melalui crawling terjadwal multi-sumber dan analisis bertenaga LLM. Menggantikan jam penelitian analis manual dengan intelijen terstruktur otomatis yang disampaikan secara real-time.
challenges: Information Overload: Analysts monitoring BBM prices and Rupiah movements had to manually check dozens of news sources, government portals, and social channels — a 3-4 hour daily task.
Source Volatility: Web scraping targets frequently change HTML structure, requiring resilient scraper architectures that don't break on minor site updates.
Sentiment Subjectivity: Raw news headlines don't capture real public sentiment — LLM analysis needed calibration to distinguish factual reporting from emotional public reaction.
Data Freshness: Economic conditions change rapidly; a 24-hour analysis lag makes intelligence irrelevant for decision-making during fast-moving events.
challenges_id: Information Overload: Analis yang memantau harga BBM dan pergerakan Rupiah harus memeriksa secara manual lusinan sumber berita, portal pemerintah, dan saluran sosial — tugas harian 3-4 jam.
Volatilitas Sumber: Target web scraping sering mengubah struktur HTML, memerlukan arsitektur scraper yang tangguh yang tidak rusak pada pembaruan situs minor.
Subjektivitas Sentimen: Berita mentah tidak menangkap sentimen publik yang sebenarnya — analisis LLM memerlukan kalibrasi untuk membedakan pelaporan faktual dari reaksi publik yang emosional.
Kesegaran Data: Kondisi ekonomi berubah dengan cepat; lag analisis 24 jam membuat intelijen tidak relevan untuk pengambilan keputusan selama peristiwa yang bergerak cepat.

solutions.title: Multi-Source Adaptive Web Crawler
solutions.desc: CSS selector-based scraper with fallback XPath patterns targets 15+ financial and government sources. Scraper health monitoring detects source structural changes and alerts for re-calibration, preventing silent data gaps.
solutions.desc_id: Scraper berbasis CSS selector dengan pola XPath fallback menargetkan 15+ sumber keuangan dan pemerintah. Monitoring kesehatan scraper mendeteksi perubahan struktural sumber dan memberi peringatan untuk re-kalibrasi, mencegah gap data yang diam.

solutions.title: LLM-Powered Structured Analysis Pipeline
solutions.desc: Scraped raw content passes through a structured LLM prompt pipeline generating: (1) factual price/rate summary, (2) public sentiment score (-5 to +5), (3) trend direction assessment, and (4) executive conclusion — all in under 8 seconds per cycle.
solutions.desc_id: Konten mentah yang di-scrape melewati pipeline prompt LLM terstruktur yang menghasilkan: (1) ringkasan harga/nilai faktual, (2) skor sentimen publik (-5 hingga +5), (3) penilaian arah tren, dan (4) kesimpulan eksekutif — semua dalam di bawah 8 detik per siklus.

solutions.title: Cron-Scheduled Intelligence Cycles
solutions.desc: Configurable cron scheduler runs crawl-analyze-store cycles at user-defined intervals (hourly to daily), ensuring intelligence freshness is tuned to the volatility of each indicator being monitored.
solutions.desc_id: Scheduler cron yang dapat dikonfigurasi menjalankan siklus crawl-analisis-simpan pada interval yang ditentukan pengguna (per jam hingga harian), memastikan kesegaran intelijen disesuaikan dengan volatilitas setiap indikator yang dipantau.

tech_reasons.reason: Python's rich scraping ecosystem enables rapid adaptation to new target sources; CSS selector + XPath dual-strategy maintains resilience against minor HTML structure changes.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Ekosistem scraping Python yang kaya memungkinkan adaptasi cepat ke sumber target baru; strategi ganda CSS selector + XPath mempertahankan ketahanan terhadap perubahan struktur HTML minor.

tech_reasons.reason: Structured output prompting (JSON mode) ensures consistent machine-parseable analysis results across thousands of crawl cycles without manual quality control.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Prompting output terstruktur (mode JSON) memastikan hasil analisis yang konsisten dan dapat di-parse mesin di ribuan siklus crawl tanpa kontrol kualitas manual.

tech_reasons.reason: FastAPI serves real-time intelligence API endpoints to the frontend dashboard; PostgreSQL stores historical trend data enabling multi-week sentiment trajectory analysis.
tech_reasons.reason_id: FastAPI menyajikan endpoint API intelijen real-time ke dashboard frontend; PostgreSQL menyimpan data tren historis yang memungkinkan analisis trajektori sentimen multi-minggu.

tech_reasons.reason: Containerized scheduler ensures consistent execution environment across deployments; cron-based scheduling provides predictable intelligence refresh cycles without infrastructure overhead.
tech_reasons.reason_id: Scheduler yang dikontainerisasi memastikan lingkungan eksekusi yang konsisten di berbagai deployment; penjadwalan berbasis cron menyediakan siklus refresh intelijen yang dapat diprediksi tanpa overhead infrastruktur.
